name: How long does a trenchless sewer repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a trenchless sewer repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trenchless sewer repair generally takes less time than traditional excavation methods. Most trenchless projects can be completed within one to three days, depending on the complexity of the job, the length of the pipe section being repaired, and the specific trenchless technique applied. Traditional methods, including excavation and backfilling, can often extend to several days or even weeks. CG Plumbing Solutions prioritizes efficient service, aiming to minimize the time your plumbing system is out of commission for residents across our service areas including North Las Vegas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trenchless sewer repair typically takes 1-3 days, significantly less than traditional methods, which can span several days or weeks.
